# 知乎 (Zhihu)

> > China's leading Q&A and knowledge-sharing platform featuring curated content, live sessions, and community-driven discussions across technology, culture, and education.

Zhihu combines question-and-answer forums with premium content including Zhihu Daily (知乎日报) - a curated digest delivered three times daily - and Zhihu Live interactive sessions on topics ranging from programming and algorithms to literature and history. The platform serves as a knowledge hub for Chinese-speaking audiences seeking expert insights and peer learning.

## Key Topics

- 知乎 (Zhihu) - Platform name
- 知乎日报 (Zhihu Daily) - Daily curated digest
- 知乎 Live - Interactive live sessions
- Knowledge sharing and Q&A
- Self-learning programming
- Algorithms and data structures
- ACM and OI competitive programming
- Software development careers
- Chinese content and community
- Mobile reading platform
- IT training and education
- Content curation
- Beginner programming guides
- Career transition resources

## Core Platform

- [知乎日报 - 每天 3 次，每次 7 分钟](https://daily.zhihu.com/?k=compilation&top): Zhihu Daily: curated knowledge compilation with 21-min avg reading time

## Programming & Technology Live Sessions

- [如何自学编程？ - 知乎 Live](https://www.zhihu.com/lives/860490807847841792): Zhihu Live session on self-learning programming by Jin Xuliang
- [如何快速攻克传统算法和数据结构？ - 知乎 Live](https://www.zhihu.com/lives/795264798257479680): Zhihu Live on mastering algorithms & data structures for interviews/ACM
